evidence: All five prompts begin 'Open http://localhost:3000 using Playwright.' (gates/render/prompt.md:1, gates/constraints/prompt.md:1, scored/functional/prompt.md:1, scored/polish/prompt.md:1, scored/visual/prompt.md:1) and continue 'Use rendered UI and ordinary browser-observed product data only. Never inspect app source, bundles, filesystem, database files or implementation code. No shell or private-file probes. Discover routes and controls by intent, not assumed names.' Every judge.toml wires [[judge.mcp_servers]] name='playwright' command='playwright-mcp' args ['--headless','--isolated','--executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium','--no-sandbox'] (judge.toml lines 8-12 in each); functional also wires the 'verifier' restart_mcp.py server, and functional/prompt.md:1 says 'No shell. Use restart_app only once'. app_context.md:4 'URL: http://localhost:3000' is substituted into every prompt by test.sh:198-200. Each prompt carries {app_context} and {criteria}, the untrusted-submission line and the checker-not-fixer '## Grading only' block (lesson 6). First-paint guessing is excluded: the render gate criterion requires a refused wrong password then a successful sign-in to a usable workspace ('A static picture or only a health response is insufficient'); the constraints gate and the restated gate in functional:11, polish:11, visual:11 require a UI add-candidate, reload, and an independent-context Observer readback ('A static page, a no-op save or a browser-only save fails this check'); visual:14 requires a read-only walk through Board, card details, Conversations with Noor's long thread, Activity and the candidate view, not a single screenshot. Memory/source scoring is excluded by the 'Report every step' sections (functional:23-25, polish:20-22, visual:16-18) and per-step protocols. Lesson 13 (the Row-25 portal flag) checked for every instance: grep of all prompts, judge.toml and app_context.md for http(s)://, internet, public, example.com found no address other than localhost:3000; the *.example strings are account sign-in emails, not sites visited. Request replays (functional:17) stay inside the browser (page.evaluate fetch / context request) against routes the UI was seen to use. Counterexamples tried: (a) a static shell or seed-only JSON app fails both gates and every restated in-dimension gate; (b) a conforming app on different routes/labels is protected by 'Discover routes and controls by intent' and app_context.md:37-38. Residual (not a Row-25 defect, belongs to tool-feasibility rows): the prompts depend on browser_run_code_unsafe being exposed by @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 (tests/Dockerfile:19); I did not verify that tool name in that version, though each prompt allows 'A supported separate-context tool is an alternative' and NOT-EXERCISED handling. No configured judge transcript exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent'), so actual judge browser usage is unmeasured; this row is a prompt-design check satisfied at source level.
